caption: The drawing depicts a single round pottery vessel with a small neck and wide body. The vessel is decorated with geometric and abstract patterns that include triangles, lines, and curved elements, distributed across the surface in segmented bands. The primary colors used in the decoration are shades of brown, black, orange, and tan, with the base color of the pottery appearing as a light beige or off-white. The vessel's mouth is shaded dark, suggesting depth. The drawing is centered on a plain background, and the edges of the paper containing the drawing are roughly cut to a shape that follows the outline of the vessel, mounted onto a larger, cleaner sheet of paper. The overall composition focuses solely on the pottery piece, with no other objects present.
title: Bowl
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
